chunks: What al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Ibn Miskān, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAjlān, who said:
Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said: If you are doubtful about zawāl, then perform the two rakʿahs; and when you are certain of zawāl, then perform the obligatory prayer.

key_terms.الزَّوَالِ: the sun's decline from the meridian, marking the start of noon prayer time

ai.seo_question: What should be done if one is unsure whether zawāl has begun before the Friday obligatory prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding prayer timing on Friday in relation to zawāl. It instructs that while one is uncertain whether zawāl has occurred, one performs the two rakʿahs, and once zawāl is certain, one performs the obligatory prayer.
